faqs.question: What is retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)?
faqs.answer: RAG is an approach that retrieves relevant information from selected data sources and supplies it to a generative model so its response can use that context.

faqs.question: How is RAG different from fine-tuning?
faqs.answer: RAG provides relevant knowledge at response time, while fine-tuning changes model behavior through additional training. They address different needs and can be used together.

faqs.question: Can a RAG system use our internal documents?
faqs.answer: Yes. A RAG system can index approved documents and knowledge sources, subject to source permissions, privacy requirements, and the chosen deployment design.

faqs.question: How can RAG reduce unsupported AI answers?
faqs.answer: Retrieval supplies relevant source context for the model to use. Evaluation, clear instructions, citations, and fallback behavior further help manage answer quality.

faqs.question: Can users see the sources behind an answer?
faqs.answer: Yes. The application can display source names, links, or cited passages alongside responses when that information is available and appropriate.

faqs.question: How do you keep indexed information up to date?
faqs.answer: We design ingestion and re-indexing workflows for your source systems, including scheduled updates or event-based processing where appropriate.

faqs.question: Can RAG respect document permissions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Access controls can be incorporated into retrieval so users only receive information they are authorized to access.

faqs.question: Which vector database or RAG framework should we use?
faqs.answer: The right choice depends on your content, scale, latency, hosting, integration, and operational requirements. We assess these before recommending an architecture.

faqs.question: How do you evaluate a RAG solution?
faqs.answer: We test retrieval relevance and answer quality against representative questions, then review grounding, citations, latency, safety, and user feedback.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a RAG system?
faqs.answer: A focused prototype can take a few weeks. Production delivery depends on the number and quality of sources, integrations, access controls, evaluation, and rollout scope.
